create_predictor: create a Predictor dataclass with initial_params and predict callables for chess model inference
build_evaluator: build an Evaluator subclass implementing step to evaluate a Predictor with given params and step number
build_data_loader: build a DataLoaderBuilder Protocol that returns a PyGrain DataLoader from a DataConfig
build_evaluator_builder: build an EvaluatorBuilder Protocol that returns an Evaluator for a given Predictor and EvalConfig
summarize_coders: summarize the CODERS dictionary mapping data field names to Apache Beam coders for chess data serialization
